title: CuRSE-Bench: A Benchmark for Probing Cultural Blind Spots in Text-to-Image Safety Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.20821v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Text-to-image (T2I) safety evaluation typically assigns each prompt or image a single culture-blind harm label, so content that is harmful only within a particular culture can pass as benign.   We introduce CultureCraft, an agentic framework that constructs T2I prompts that appear benign under a general-purpose rubric yet carry a latent harmful meaning in a target culture, and use it to build CuRSE-Bench: 10,709 culture-specific prompts and 2,648 culture-general controls over six regions and ten harm axes, each drawn from a predefined knowledge base of documented harm vectors and traceable to at least two independent sources.   Scoring every prompt under six region persona judges and a paired culture-blind judge, we find that the culture-blind judge under-rates culture-specific latent harm while matching the persona judges on the controls. translated_title: CuRSE-Bench：一个用于探测文生图安全评估中文化盲点的基准测试
translated_abstract: 文生图安全评估通常为每个提示词或图像分配单一的文化无关危害标签，因此仅在特定文化中才有害的内容可能被误判为无害。我们提出了CultureCraft，这是一个智能体框架，用于构建在通用评估标准下看似无害、却在目标文化中带有潜在有害含义的文生图提示词，并利用它构建了CuRSE-Bench：包含10,709个特定文化提示词和2,648个通用文化对照提示词，覆盖六个地区和十个危害维度，每个提示词均源自预定义的已记录危害向量知识库，且可追溯至至少两个独立来源。通过六个地区人格化评判者（persona judges）和一个配对的文化无关评判者对每个提示词进行评分，我们发现文化无关评判者会低估特定文化的潜在危害，而在对照提示词上则与人格化评判者的表现一致。每个地区的人格化评判者反过来在我们的评测工具下主要能够解读其所属地区的潜在危害……
tldr: 该论文提出CultureCraft智能体框架并构建了CuRSE-Bench基准（包含10,709个特定文化提示词和2,648个对照提示词，覆盖六个地区和十个危害维度），揭示了现有文生图安全评估因文化盲点而无法识别仅在特定文化中构成潜在危害的内容。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CultureCraft, an agentic framework for constructing culturally latent harmful prompts, and CuRSE-Bench, a benchmark of 10,709 culture-specific prompts and 2,648 controls across six regions and ten harm axes, revealing that current culture-blind text-to-image safety evaluations fail to detect harms that are only meaningful within particular cultures.
